_comment: Blocking checks that are ALREADY red, were red before the work being shipped,
and are not what stands between Trikzos and a playable build.
A waiver does not make a check pass. It says: this one is inherited, we know
why it is here, someone owns it, and it is not worth costing him another day
without a build. ship_apk.sh prints every waiver on the console and in
SHIP_REPORT.md, every single run, so a waiver cannot quietly become normal.
1. Every waiver carries a reason and an owning task. No bare check names.
2. Every waiver expires. Past 'expires' the check blocks again and the
build is withheld until someone either fixes it or consciously renews.
3. The checks in UNWAIVABLE inside ship_apk.sh cannot be listed here at
all — the build, the engine tests, input smoke, loop smoke and the
three install-critical APK facts. Those ARE the promise that the build
is worth opening; waiving one would be lying to him. ship_apk.sh
refuses to run if this file tries.
